description: Changes a saved card's design. Only the fields passed change; the rest stay as they are. Customers' passes in Apple Wallet and Google Wallet update automatically.

auxiliary_fields.description: Up to two extra front-of-pass fields, e.g. {label: "Perk", value: "10% off pastries"}.

header_text.description: Text at the top of the pass. Defaults to the store name. Wallet apps truncate long headers, so keep it short.

initial_stamps.description: Stamps a new customer starts with (a head start). Must be less than stamps_required.

logo_url.description: Public https URL of the wide logo shown top-left of the Apple pass (PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF or SVG; transparent PNG works best). Ideally a version that reads on card_color.

name.description: Internal name for the card, e.g. "Coffee card". Shown in Leal, not on the pass.

show_member_field.description: Show the customer's name on the front of the pass. Default true.

show_stamps_to_reward_field.description: Show how many stamps until the next reward. Default true.

square_logo_url.description: Public https URL of a square logo or icon, used as the round logo on Google Wallet.

stamp_background_color.description: Fill colour of a collected stamp circle, hex. Empty stamp slots use a translucent version of it, so it should stand out from the strip.

stamp_color.description: Colour of the icon inside a collected stamp, hex. Must read clearly on stamp_background_color.

stamp_icon.description: Icon shown in each collected stamp.

stamps_required.description: Stamps needed to fill the card. 6, 8 or 10 are common.

strip_color.description: Strip colour, hex. Also shows behind preset and image strips when strip_opacity is below 100.

strip_image_url.description: Public https URL of a wide photo for the strip (strip_type image), e.g. a hero image from the brand's website. Cropped to 375×144.

strip_opacity.description: Opacity of the strip colour or image over the card colour. 100 shows it exactly; 60–85 tints a photo with the card colour so stamps stand out.

strip_preset.description: Preset strip photo, used when strip_type is preset.

strip_type.description: Background of the stamp strip: a flat colour, one of Leal's preset photos, or an image from strip_image_url.

text_color.description: Colour of all text on the pass, hex. Must read clearly on card_color (4.5:1 contrast or better).

title: Update a loyalty card
